stories.title: Europese Commissie wil een harde leeftijdsgrens voor kinderen op sociale media: 13 jaar

en.title: European Commission wants hard age limit for children on social media: 13 years
en.summary: The European Commission is proposing new legislation to protect children from social media companies by implementing stricter algorithms and limiting notification systems.

stories.title: Pro staat open voor bezuinigingen op de zorg, maar niet déze bezuinigingen

en.title: Pro open to healthcare cuts, but not these cuts
en.summary: The SP party fracton leader states the party takes a firm stance on social security cuts while questioning whether the same firmness applies to planned healthcare budget reductions.

stories.title: Trump trotseert vonnis: Kennedy Center sluit per direct, verbouwing gaat niet door als naam niet op gevel komt

en.title: Trump defies ruling: Kennedy Center closes immediately, renovation halted if name not displayed on facade
en.summary: The Kennedy Center has closed and halted renovations over a dispute regarding whether Trump's name appears on the building's exterior.

stories.title: Europese Commissie wil verbod op sociale media voor kinderen onder 13 jaar en beperkt gebruik tot 15 jaar

en.title: European Commission wants ban on social media for children under 13 years and limited use until 15 years
en.summary: The European Commission is proposing restrictions on social media access for children under 13 and limited usage provisions for those under 15 years old.

stories.title: Gerechtigheid voor familieleden vermoorde Ikon-journalisten: ‘Ik ben opgelucht, maar mijn broer krijg ik niet terug’

en.title: Justice for families of murdered Ikon journalists: 'I am relieved, but I don't get my brother back'
en.summary: Family members of murdered Ikon journalists have received justice in a legal case. A relative expressed relief at the outcome while acknowledging the permanent loss of their loved one.

stories.title: Von der Leyen wil Europese Veiligheidsraad en Canada 'associatielid' maken

en.title: Von der Leyen wants European Security Council and Canada as 'associate member'
en.summary: EU Commission President Ursula von der Leyen proposed establishing a European Security Council and suggested making Canada the first associate member of the EU during her State of the Union address.

stories.title: EU wil verbod op sociale media voor kinderen tot dertien jaar

en.title: EU wants to ban social media for children under thirteen years
en.summary: The European Commission proposed legislation to prohibit access to social media platforms including Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat for children under thirteen years old.

stories.title: Medewerker Franse naschoolse opvang krijgt jaar huisarrest voor seksueel misbruik

en.title: French after-school care worker receives one year house arrest for sexual abuse
en.summary: A Paris after-school care worker was sentenced to one year house arrest and a four-year conditional prison sentence for sexually abusing nine girls aged five to ten between September 2022 and January 2024.

stories.title: Von der Leyen roept in jaarlijkse toespraak op tot oprichten Europese Veiligheidsraad

en.title: Von der Leyen calls for establishment of European Security Council in annual speech
en.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen urged the EU to become independent in security matters and proposed creating a European Security Council that would include Canada, the UK, Norway, and Ukraine alongside NATO.

stories.title: Voorprogramma's en band Ed Sheeran verlaten tour na schrappen Macklemore

en.title: Opening acts and Ed Sheeran's band leave tour after Macklemore dropped
en.summary: Ed Sheeran's backing band and remaining opening acts withdrew from his American Loop tour following the removal of rapper Macklemore as an opener due to pro-Palestine statements made on stage.

stories.title: Trump sluit Kennedy Center zolang zijn naam niet op gevel mag van rechter

en.title: Trump withholds Kennedy Center renovation unless his name permitted on building by court
en.summary: President Trump will not allow renovation of the Kennedy Center unless a court ruling permits his name to appear on the building's exterior.

stories.title: Rechter blokkeert naam Trump op Kennedy Center weer, gebouw per direct dicht

en.title: Judge blocks Trump name at Kennedy Center again, building closed immediately
en.summary: A federal court in Washington D.C. has again prohibited placing President Trump's name on the Kennedy Center's exterior or renaming its associated plaza. Following the ruling, the institution's board immediately closed the building citing safety concerns.
